analysis_unit: Integrated comparative package; adapted same ten-weight rubric, not per-file certification or 14-criterion lifecycle score

criteria.name: Purpose and boundaries
criteria.basis: C0 resolved at the pair interface: one baseline/owner/verdict, A requirements and B selected tool implementation.

criteria.name: Domain value and context cost
criteria.basis: A W2 retains bounded conditional recap/PDF-example duplication; B unique executable machinery retained.

criteria.name: Inputs, outputs and expected outcomes
criteria.basis: A ten stages; B frozen expectations precede execution and comparison/YAML producer-consumer contracts agree.

criteria.name: Correctness and authority
criteria.basis: B verdict-count rejection and current hook protocol corrected; local conventions bounded.

criteria.name: Usability and discovery
criteria.basis: A conditional routing; B contents maps and real browser row labels/focus verified.

criteria.name: Failure handling and proportional controls
criteria.basis: B concise malformed-input diagnostics, resolved-source/case state exclusions and required-entrypoint failure tested.

criteria.name: Validation and evidence integrity
criteria.basis: Same material-gap cap for both: current integrated activation/application and paired acceptance remain unverified. A W3 reconstruction limit is included, not charged again; B C5 provenance contradiction closed.

criteria.name: Package integration
criteria.basis: Source mappings support intentional composition; B schema/parser/consumer contracts corrected. No automatic adapter claimed.

criteria.name: Maintainability
criteria.basis: Provider applicability, mechanical record refresh conditions and evidence boundaries explicit.

criteria.name: Mechanical integrity
criteria.basis: Fresh tests/validators and B source-identical repaired links/schema record checks pass.

baseline_adjustment: Apply V11 to both wherever required current integrated behavior remains NHR. Original A V14 becomes V11; preserve original published records. B original C5 provenance/runtime gaps share existing V11 cap, do not stack deductions.
structural_disposition: Keep both packages distinct with explicit responsibility split
